key_insight: HISPO improves reinforcement learning for math reasoning by assigning credit at the segment level, sitting between token-level and sequence-level importance-sampling methods.
engineering_relevance: For long-form reasoning models, segment-level optimization offers a practical way to reduce credit-assignment noise and can improve reliability on benchmark math tasks.
method: Build contiguous response segments from rollout-time entropy
Use entropy-derived saliency weights to emphasize more informative segments
Apply clipped importance-sampling correction at the segment granularity
evidence_signal: Fine-tuning Qwen3-1.7B-Base on six math benchmarks, HISPO outperformed the strongest baseline in Pass@8 on all benchmarks and improved AIME25 by +3.75 Acc@8 and +3.78 Pass@8 over GRPO.
watch_item: Entropy-based segmentation and weighting add extra design choices that may affect stability, sensitivity, and reproducibility across models or reward setups.
paper_title: HISPO: Hierarchical Importance-Sampling Policy Optimization with Entropy-Derived Segments
